answer: Reputation-Weighted Task Assignment: each new agent identity starts at zero trust, like a bare glacier, and receives only low-value tasks until it completes a track record. Existing agents preferentially route work through established partners, so a clone earns almost nothing while paying full registration and compute costs. Like a falcon stooping on prey, fraud detection flags clusters that share timing or infrastructure, freezing their earnings. Every identity an attacker creates costs more than its expected slice of the vine of routed work.
